{{Quote|The Unknown Master, who came to Vaklin on his deathbed but never revealed his name.|Namada mentions the Master in her report.|<ref name="TTF2" />}}
The '''Unknown Master''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Shortly before his [[Death/Legends|death]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]], where he did not reveal his name even as he died. He was commemorated by a [[Statuary|statue]] by the local population.

==Biography==
The Unknown Master was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. During the Master's final days, he traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]], where he [[Death/Legends|died]] without telling any of the local population his name. The locals commemorated the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] by building a [[Statuary|statue]] of him in a public square in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vaklin Zenith]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the dissolution of the Jedi Order, an [[Vaklin insurgency|insurgency]] against the Empire took place on Vaklin, and the memorial was destroyed. It was destroyed by the Empire in an attempt at wiping out all memory of the Order's existence on Vaklin, which they hoped would reduce the populations support for the Jedi-led insurgency. [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Oniye Namada]] mentioned the Unknown Master in a report she wrote detailing the Insurgency, titled [[I-1807-VAK]].<ref name="TTF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Unknown Master was first mentioned in [[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 2]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Alexander Freed]] and released in [[2013]] and part of the [[Purge (comic book)|''Star Wars: Purge'']] series. The book does not make clear what era he lived in or what his [[Species/Legends|species]] was, although statues in the square include a [[Myneyrsh]] and a [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]].
